title: Proximity to a linear function from BLR acceptance
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$ be a function, and let $\varepsilon$ be real. If the probability that uniformly chosen $x,y\in\mathbb F_2^n$ satisfy $f(x)+f(y)=f(x+y)$ is $1-\varepsilon$, then there is a linear function $g:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$ whose relative Hamming distance from $f$ is at most $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: Function f from the Boolean vector space to the two-element field
BLR acceptance probability of f equals 1 - ε
